processed_interface.eligible_filter: document_chembl_id == CHEMBL5674852 and assay_chembl_id == CHEMBL5674853 and papp_ab nonmissing and papp_ba nonmissing
processed_interface.weak_binary_sensitivity_rule: efflux_ratio >= 2 is high-efflux-like; efflux_ratio < 2 is low-efflux-like; nonestimable rows excluded
processed_interface.identity_audit: all 132 reconstructed observations are exact- and connectivity-new to the frozen 443, Soskuti development, prior Q1 external, regulatory v4, batch5 reserved, and NPMMP weak-pair sets

primary_endpoint: Spearman correlation between frozen model probability and log2(efflux_ratio) on the 62 estimable rows
secondary_endpoints: ROC-AUC for the weak ER >= 2 sensitivity label
balanced accuracy at each model's already-frozen threshold
Brier score for the weak ER >= 2 sensitivity label
coverage and metrics by frozen applicability band

predeclared_directional_gate.rule: Spearman point estimate > 0 and 95% Murcko-scaffold bootstrap lower bound > 0
predeclared_directional_gate.interpretation_if_pass: source-heldout continuous direction is supported in one MDCK-MDR1 vendor dataset
predeclared_directional_gate.interpretation_if_fail: do not tune on this source; retain only bounded screening and assay-boundary claims

prohibitions: no refit, recalibration, feature selection, threshold selection, or model choice using CHEMBL5674852 outcomes
no matched-parent, inhibitor-rescue, universal substrate, intact-ADC, or ADC release-species claim
no conversion of the 61 unidirectional-only source molecules into ABCB1 labels
no treating repeated observations or same-scaffold rows as independent bootstrap units
claim_boundary: retrospective but model-frozen source-heldout continuous evaluation; one vendor protocol without matched parental or inhibitor control
